d: Vijay Sinha on Dimagi Naxal :pradhanmantri narendr modi ne chhattisgarh ke bastar men suraksha balon ke satha dipavli manaee aur desh ko 'dimagi naksal' se satark rahne ki apil ki... piem modi ke bayan ka samarthan karte hue bihar sarkar men vijay sinha ne kaha ki hamare desh ke pradhanmantri 'sabka sath, sabka vikas' ke raste par chalne ki parikalpana karte hain, lekin kuchh aise log bhi hain, jo desh ke dushman hain aur arajakta phailana chahte hain... sinha ne kaha ki aise log buddhijivi hone ka dhong rachkar, yuvaon ko gumrah karne aur desh ki janta ko baraglane ki koshish karte…
